example.title: Dana Point Harbor East Basin main dock
example.place: Dana Point Harbor, Dana Point, Orange County, CA

brief: The East Basin's main floating dock (1971): a long concrete-pontoon walkway held by guide piles, with short fingers and power pedestals, sport boats and cabin cruisers moored along it. One photo. Piles carried 10 m or more below the modelled bed (spec rule 4).
